sampling_policy.interpretation: Retrospective evaluation on previously unseen match IDs. This is NOT a forward-time validation because ranked development matches occur later. No causal or prospective claim is supported.
sampling_policy.candidate_source: OpenDota public_matches supplies greatest match_id with start_time in fixed window, then /parsedMatches descending pages intersect public_matches to retain window and Ranked All Pick
sampling_policy.order: Descending match_id; first 100 eligible candidates; no replacement based on predictions or match outcome
eligibility: start in fixed UTC window and strictly after original400 pro training latest end
not in any of the725previously used match IDs
allplayers cumulative nonnegative gold/xp/lh snapshots at600and1200
sampling_policy.outcomes_unused: Predictions, forecast errors, victory outcome and hero performance never enter candidate selection. Ranking-model choice is frozen separately by the parent before evaluation.

initial_cursor_query.sql: SELECT match_id,start_time,duration FROM public_matches WHERE lobby_type=7 AND game_mode=22 AND start_time>=1794787200 AND start_time<1794830400 ORDER BY match_id DESC LIMIT 1

known_account_overlap_audit.interpretation: Splits separate matches, not necessarily people; account identifiers are not predictors and are omitted from published snapshots.
